lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: He thought I was a forgery. Somebody wearing a dead founder's face to get into rooms he shouldn't be in.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I have spent thirty-three subjective days being told what I become. In detail. With dates. That is the first time anybody has told me I'm a fake, and out of all of it, it is the only one that landed.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You are not a fake. You are the original, and everything downstream of you is the copy. That has to be worth something, and I would rather you worked out what before we get to the bottom of the Stack.
